svg.title: AI-assisted transformation accelerated airline crew operations while preserving critical business rules
svg.desc: Anonymous transportation and logistics case study showing how domain knowledge connected five airline application domains within a broader code estate and accelerated the transformation of complex crew operations.
svg.text: AI-assisted transformation of airline crew operations
Domain knowledge and governed engineering accelerated change across a deeply interconnected operating environment
Business rules and controls had to hold
Code, process flows, rules and dependencies
Linked shared rules and dependencies across the broader code estate
AI-assisted analysis, design and engineering with continuous verification
LINES OF CODE ACROSS THE ESTATE
The delivery model accelerated change while preserving the rules that keep crew operations running
